user.title: Connect to SparkyFitness
user.description: Enter the SparkyFitness base URL or its /mcp endpoint and a personal API key.

data_description.account_name: Optional label used to distinguish multiple API keys on the same server.
data_description.verify_ssl: Keep enabled unless you understand the security risk of an unverified certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate SparkyFitness
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected or revoked. Enter a new personal API key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SparkyFitness
reconfigure.description: Change the MCP endpoint or TLS certificate policy. The existing API key will be reused and validated.

data_description.verify_ssl: Keep enabled unless you understand the security risk of an unverified certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the SparkyFitness MCP endpoint.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or was revoked.
error.invalid_mcp_server: The endpoint is not a compatible SparkyFitness MCP server.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.timeout: The SparkyFitness MCP endpoint timed out.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This SparkyFitness account is already configured.

init.title: SparkyFitness options
init.description: Disabling TLS verification exposes the API key and health data to interception. Feature switches also prevent their MCP polling calls.

unsupported_feature.message: The connected SparkyFitness server does not support this action: {error}

entry_not_loaded.message: The SparkyFitness config entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

no_loaded_entry.message: No loaded SparkyFitness config entry exists.

entry_id_required.message: Multiple SparkyFitness entries exist; provide config_entry_id.

date_fields_mutually_exclusive.message: Use date or start_date/end_date, not both.

end_date_before_start.message: end_date must not be before start_date.

biometric_required.message: At least one biometric measurement is required.

food_update_required.message: Provide quantity, unit, meal_type, or meal_type_id.

exercise_update_required.message: At least one exercise entry field is required.

goal_required.message: At least one goal value is required.

missing_tools.title: Enabled SparkyFitness features are unavailable
missing_tools.description: The connected MCP server does not expose these tools required by enabled feature groups: {tools}. Update SparkyFitness or use Repair to disable only the affected feature groups.

confirm.title: Disable unavailable SparkyFitness features
confirm.description: The following feature groups require tools that the MCP server does not expose: {features}. Continue to disable only these groups and reload the integration.

abort.entry_not_found: The SparkyFitness config entry no longer exists.

unsupported_protocol.title: Unverified MCP protocol version
unsupported_protocol.description: The server negotiated MCP protocol version {version}, which this integration has not verified. Update the integration or use a supported SparkyFitness release.

authentication_failed.title: SparkyFitness authentication failed
authentication_failed.description: The API key was rejected or revoked. Open the SparkyFitness integration and complete reauthentication.
